spec.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
taskFacts: Find the shortest nonempty contiguous segment in an array of positive integers whose sum is at least target.
Return its length, or zero if no such segment exists. An O(n log n) alternative after finding an O(n) method is an optional follow-up.

examples.explanation: The final two values meet the target with the shortest possible length.
Even the full array is too small.
